CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_DEPOSITS_P2] AS

BEGIN

		DECLARE @FLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]
		DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*)				
		FROM 
			(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%DEP%') OTR
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT OTR.TASK_NAME),
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(DD.FULLDATE)
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			ON
			EC.DEPOSITS_DATE_P2=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			AND 
            DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='DEP'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='DEP'
            AND OT.DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
            AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2'
			AND COALESCE(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = 2
  

		SELECT 
			@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT TASK_NAME) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='DEP'
            AND DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
            AND TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2'
			AND COALESCE(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = 2
            

		IF(@FLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@FLAG_TASK_CNT AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			BEGIN

                DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL DEPOSITS JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL 'WORKFLOW_EDS_DEP_P2', 'TSK_CTL_DEP_UPD', 'CTL', @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE, @errmsg1;
				--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL DEPOSITS JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50001, @errmsg1, 1;
			END
			
		IF(@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NULL)
			BEGIN

                DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL 'WORKFLOW_EDS_DEP_P2', 'TSK_CTL_DEP_UPD', 'CTL', @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE, @errmsg2;
				--RAISERROR('NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50002, @errmsg2, 1; 
			END
			
		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET DEPOSITS_DATE_P2=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE
	
	END

GO
